articles.summary: Many kids love being on the computer, but for parents, it's often a question of how to turn that interest into something meaningful. Matias's parents wanted to do just that — support his curiosity, build his confidence, and give him the chance to create something he could be proud of.
articles.title: From Gamer to Game Creator: How Matias Built His Own AI-Powered World

articles.title: Meet Asha: The Strive Teacher Who Makes Students Feel Like a Boss
